descriptions.preferred: This unique upright red dissectum introduced by Duncan and Davies Nursery of New Zealand can be described as the red counterpart to the ever-popular upright green dissectum 'Seiryu'\. In spring its foliage is similar in color to that of 'Crimson Queen', and it retains this purple red well into the summer, becoming bronzed with green undertones in early fall. It turns a deep crimson in the fall. The seven-lobed leaves are dissected to the leaf base, and are 7-9 cm long and 9-11 cm wide. The lobes themselves are deeply incised and, with the sublobes, are 1-2 cm wide at the broadest point, narrowing sharply in the lower quarter to no more than the width of the midribs for a distance of 1-1. 5 cm to the leaf base. The margins have coarse but narrow, finely pointed double teeth. The red petioles are 1. 5-3 cm long with expanded bases. When young the attractive deep red bark is covered in very close-packed vertical glaucous striations. attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this dissectum group have fine, feathery, deeply divided leaves with finely serrated edges

care.cultivation: Grow in any moisture-retentive, well-drained soil in a sheltered position. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated if soil is reliably moist. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure. Suits container cultivation but attention to watering is needed in dry spells during the growing season. See Japanese maples cultivation
care.pruning: Pruning group 1 from late autumn to midwinter only
care.propagation: Propagate by layering in autumn, grafting in late winter or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: dissectum 组的槭树具有细致、羽毛状、深裂的叶片，叶缘具细锯齿。

care.pruning: 修剪第 1 组：仅限在晚秋至仲冬期间进行。
care.propagation: 可于秋季行压条繁殖，于晚冬进行嫁接，或采用软枝扦插繁殖。
care.cultivation: 宜栽培于保水性好且排水良好的土壤中，选择避风庇护的位置。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳；若土壤湿度稳定充足，也可耐全日照。土壤缺水或暴露过度易导致叶缘焦枯。适合容器栽培，但生长季遇干旱天气时需特别注意浇水。另见 Japanese maples cultivation。

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感 Verticillium wilt、槭树叶灼病和蜜环菌。

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Lionheart' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum dissectum 'Lionheart' Large Red Laceleaf Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 'Lionheart' is a superb red laceleaf selection of Japanese maple. 'Lionheart' leafs out in the spring as a pink-red to bright red turning maroon for a big part of year. During late summer, 'Lionheart' may turn to shades of bronze, before turning orange to crimson red in the fall. The most unique thing about 'Lionheart' is its habit, often reaching upward at early age, growing with a bit of vigor. As 'Lionheart' begins to age it does begin weep. This habit creates a layering effect with quite a bit of arching. 'Lionheart' may reach 8-10 ft in height and width in 15 years.
